description: Explicit source map for characterization/SUMMARY.md. Sources are listed by hand; sim/ is never globbed. sha256 values are filled by `gen_summary.py --update-hashes` and verified in CI. No spec or target values appear here.

sections.title: SG13CMOS5L: nominal single-point and closed-loop results (failures retained)

gaps.title: No ratified spec table
gaps.text: There is no ratified target spec to compare against. This summary therefore carries no pass/fail-versus-spec column and derives no target from any measurement.

gaps.title: Partial PVT axes
gaps.text: Most campaigns use a 3-bundle PVT convention (typ/slow/fast), a fixed supply (3.3 V) and a subset of band codes or trim codes; none is a full cross-product. Each dataset lists the corner coverage actually present in its CSVs. Targeted fine-trim and nominal records cover single tuples only.

gaps.title: Bodyfix (#136) not re-verified across PVT
gaps.text: The lock_detector bulk-on-VSS change (#136) was verified at the nominal corner only (RECORD-005). The last full-PVT evidence is for the previous DUT.

gaps.title: lock_detector PVT gaps
gaps.text: The full-PVT lock_detector grid for the current DUT is owed.

gaps.title: lock_detector post-layout/PEX gap
gaps.text: lock_detector PEX evidence is stale relative to the current GDS and withheld from T1 item 7.

gaps.title: Divider speed evidence
gaps.text: Maximum-input-frequency evidence for the repaired divider_chain is not part of this summary's selected sources; the SG13G2 divider has none.

gaps.title: Charge-pump dump-node correction
gaps.text: The cp numbers here are for the DUT before the VDUMP-tracks-VOUT correction; the static phase error failure (row 7) is unresolved.

gaps.title: cp up/dn mismatch Monte Carlo not run
gaps.text: The hv MOS mismatch model is confirmed live and the bench's controls pass (sg13cmos5l-cp-icp-trim-mc RECORD-001), but the Monte Carlo campaign is blocked on the batch fleet (klayout-tools#2727, #2851, #2901). No cp mismatch yield estimate exists.

gaps.title: cp tracking dump buffer (DR-010) nominal-only, layout stale
gaps.text: The VDUMP-tracks-VOUT buffer (DR-010) is evidenced at mos_tt/27 C/3.3 V only: the |VDUMP-VOUT| offset across PVT, the cp-icp-trim re-run across PVT, row 7 across PVT, Monte Carlo (random offset) and low Icp*Tref are owed (batch fleet: klayout-tools#2727, #2851, #2901). The committed cp layout, and its LVS/ERC/DRC/PEX evidence, still describe the pre-#165 buffer until #195.
